note: Exploratory data mining on detrended monthly anomalies. It does not replace the trend statistics and does not show cause and effect.
detrending_note: Each series has its own least-squares linear trend removed before states are assigned. Rules and the variable screening use the trend of the whole table period (descriptive). The decision tree re-estimates monthly means, trend and target thresholds from the training months of each fold only.

variable_names.modis_lst_pc: Daytime land surface temperature (MODIS Terra, via Planetary Computer)
variable_names.modis_ndvi_pc: Vegetation greenness, NDVI (MODIS Terra 250 m 16-day, via Planetary Computer)

significance_note: Each rule has a one-sided Fisher exact test on the 2x2 table of left side holds or not by right side holds or not, with Benjamini-Hochberg correction across all candidate rules of the same table and timing. Transactions are not independent (neighbouring months, neighbouring locations), so the p and q values are optimistic.
gap_filling_note: Gaps are filled on the monthly anomaly before the table is built: runs of up to max_linear_gap_months missing months are linearly interpolated, longer runs are set to 0 (the monthly climatology), nothing is extrapolated before the first or after the last usable month of a series, and the previous month is never carried forward. Series with more than max_fill_fraction of their months filled are left out. gap_filling_sensitivity compares this run with the same run without filling.

gap_filling_sensitivity.note: The results in this file are the filled run. The unfilled run uses the same parameters with fill_gaps switched.
